name: dev.predictionmarketapi/polymarket-kalshi-odds-events-mcp
title: PredictionMarketAPI — Polymarket & Kalshi Real-Time Odds MCP
description: Real-time Polymarket and Kalshi prediction market odds, orderbooks, probabilities, and events API.

tools.name: search_prediction_markets
tools.description: Search live open event contracts across Polymarket and Kalshi (CFTC-regulated exchange) with normalized yes_probability, no_probability, spread_bps, 24h volume, liquidity, close_time, resolution_source, and CLOB token IDs. Cost: 2 Credits / market returned (0 Credits if empty).

venue.description: Venue filter: all (default), polymarket, or kalshi.

tools.name: get_market_detail
tools.description: Retrieve complete contract metadata, official resolution rules, outcome implied probabilities, 24h delta, liquidity, CLOB token IDs, and PostgreSQL hourly probability history snapshots for a Polymarket market_id/slug or Kalshi ticker. Cost: 10 Credits / call (0 Credits on 404).

market_id.description: Polymarket market_id/slug (e.g. "559651" or "pm_559651") or Kalshi ticker (e.g. "KXELONMARS-99").

tools.name: get_market_orderbook
tools.description: Fetch live normalized bid/ask orderbook levels, best_bid, best_ask, mid_price implied probability, spread_bps, and total USD notional depth from Polymarket CLOB (by token_id) or Kalshi Exchange (by ticker) or unified market_id. Cost: 5 Credits / call (0 Credits on 404).

token_id.description: Polymarket CLOB asset token_id from clob_token_ids.

market_id.description: Unified market_id (auto-resolves CLOB token_id or Kalshi ticker).

tools.name: get_market_movers
tools.description: Track the sharpest 24-hour implied-probability shifts and highest-liquidity macroeconomic, tech, policy, and digital-asset event contracts across Polymarket and Kalshi. Cost: 2 Credits / mover returned.

tools.name: compare_cross_venue_probabilities
tools.description: Search both Polymarket and Kalshi simultaneously for a macro, geopolitical, or technology topic to inspect cross-venue implied-probability consensus, spreads, and liquidity depth in one call. Cost: 2 Credits / market returned.

query.description: Event topic to compare across venues (e.g. "fed", "recession", "bitcoin", "ai").
